bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to energy; appropriating money to construct a geothermal energy system.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; GEOTHERMAL ENERGY SYSTEM. +]

[+(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $2,250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the renewable development account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to Como Zoo in the city of St. Paul to construct a geothermal energy system that provides space heating and cooling to the large cats building. +]

[+(b) For the purposes of this section, "geothermal energy system" means a system composed of a heat pump that moves a heat-transferring fluid through piping embedded in the earth and absorbs the earth's constant temperature, a heat exchanger, and ductwork to distribute heated and cooled air to a building. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to energy; appropriating money to construct a geothermal energy system.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; GEOTHERMAL ENERGY SYSTEM.

(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $2,250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the renewable development account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to Como Zoo in the city of St. Paul to construct a geothermal energy system that provides space heating and cooling to the large cats building.

(b) For the purposes of this section, "geothermal energy system" means a system composed of a heat pump that moves a heat-transferring fluid through piping embedded in the earth and absorbs the earth's constant temperature, a heat exchanger, and ductwork to distribute heated and cooled air to a building.
additions: (a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $2,250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the renewable development account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to Como Zoo in the city of St. Paul to construct a geothermal energy system that provides space heating and cooling to the large cats building.

(b) For the purposes of this section, "geothermal energy system" means a system composed of a heat pump that moves a heat-transferring fluid through piping embedded in the earth and absorbs the earth's constant temperature, a heat exchanger, and ductwork to distribute heated and cooled air to a building.
